A full Diablo III-style UI for the WoW 3.3.5a client: Goldpaw's DiabolicUI, forked and extended for 3.3.5.

image::docs/screenshots/main.webp[DiabolicUI in Winterspring]

== 🚀 Install

. Download the zip from https://github.com/apt-get-update/DiabolicUI/releases/latest[the latest release].
. Unzip it into `Interface/AddOns/`.
. In game: `/dui config` for the options, `/dui move` to move frames.

What's new in each version: https://github.com/apt-get-update/DiabolicUI/releases[releases].

== ✨ Features

* Action bars between Diablo III's health and mana orbs, with cooldown times.
* Unit frames, nameplates, chat, minimap, tooltips, quest tracker and Blizzard's windows (character, spellbook, auction house...) restyled in the spirit of Diablo III.
* A specialization button that also swaps gear set, action bars and macros.
* An optional roll window for master loot.
* Quality of life: GearScore on gear and players, a stance button, clickable web links, shorter chat messages, frames you can move and a UI scale.
